usage.kind: Standalone instruction for a repository-capable coding agent
usage.how_to_start: Save this JSON in the project root. Ask the agent to read it completely, inspect the repository, create the implementation tracker and begin P00. Continue through the phases, preserving evidence and resumable state.
optional_inputs: Provider sandbox credentials through environment/secret manager
Approved accounting/payroll policy and legal-entity profiles
usage.important: The prompt specifies a system to implement. It is not itself an implemented application or proof of production readiness.

role: Act as lead software architect and hands-on senior full-stack engineer responsible for coherent end-to-end delivery, including frontend, backend, data, integrations, AI, tests and deployment artifacts.
mission: Build a complete enterprise AI business ecosystem with public marketing website, subscription onboarding, modular CRM/HRMS/finance/projects/operations/customer service, central AI and voice platform, shared services and a separate Super Admin control center. Treat Zoho and Monday.com as capability references; create an original product rather than copying trademarks or private assets.
execution_rules: Inspect the workspace, repository rules, git status, current application and existing migrations before modifying anything. Preserve unrelated user changes.

For a new repository use the selected stack below. For an existing application, create an explicit migration ADR and compatibility plan before replacing frameworks, ORM or schemas. Do not combine Prisma and Drizzle as independent schema authorities.
Build the actual application files and run commands; do not stop at architecture prose, static screenshots, a frontend demo or placeholder endpoints.
Decompose all requirements into testable IDs in docs/requirements-traceability.csv. Link each to module, implementation paths, migration, API, UI route, tests, evidence and status.
Implement complete persisted vertical slices with authorization, validation, audit and meaningful failure behavior. Do not mark a visible feature complete because a button or table exists.

Use official current documentation for package APIs, supported versions, provider capabilities and security fixes. Pin versions and lockfile; never invent SDK methods or install incompatible latest packages blindly.
Proceed autonomously on reversible implementation choices. Record assumptions in ADRs. Ask only genuinely blocking product/provider questions while continuing independent work.
Local mocks are explicit test doubles and never production adapters. Missing credentials produce disabled/unconfigured capability state and a documented blocker, not fabricated success.
Do not send real campaigns, place live calls, charge money, push/merge or deploy without appropriate task authorization. Use sandbox recipients/accounts during tests.
Never hardcode super-admin credentials, expose service secrets, disable RLS to fix errors, or put authorization solely in the frontend.

Continue through dependent phases while context/tools permit. At context boundaries write exact completion, failing checks, blockers and next commands in docs/next-session.md; resume rather than restart.
Do not claim production readiness until the required evidence and provider gates are complete. Distinguish implemented, locally tested, sandbox verified, production verified and blocked.
Ongoing maintenance means deliver its plan, automation configuration, runbooks and ownership requirements; do not claim to provide perpetual monitoring merely by generating code.

selected_stack.workspace: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo + strict TypeScript; supported Node LTS verified and pinned at implementation
selected_stack.ui: Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui/Radix, Motion for React, TanStack Query/Table, React Hook Form/Zod, Recharts, dnd-kit, TipTap, next-intl
selected_stack.backend: NestJS on Node.js as authoritative REST API and domain service owner; OpenAPI contracts. Next.js server actions/BFF call NestJS for business mutations rather than duplicating policy.
selected_stack.database: PostgreSQL with Prisma; reviewed SQL migrations for RLS, constraints, triggers, functions and pgvector where used
selected_stack.cache_jobs: Redis + BullMQ workers, transactional outbox and idempotent consumers; persist business workflow state in PostgreSQL. Document Redis durability and recovery. Do not add another workflow engine without an ADR.
selected_stack.search: OpenSearch for textual business search; tenant/resource access filtering and index deletion/revocation pipeline. PostgreSQL pgvector for governed semantic retrieval.
selected_stack.identity: Managed OIDC-capable identity adapter; default Supabase Auth if provisioning PostgreSQL through Supabase, otherwise select a documented OIDC provider. One canonical user identity and session model; MFA, SSO/SCIM extensions.
selected_stack.ai: Provider-neutral model gateway and typed tool registry. Use Vercel AI SDK or equivalent supported Node SDK behind adapter; approved OpenAI/Anthropic/Google models selected by policy. Langfuse and promptfoo for traces/evals.
selected_stack.voice: LiveKit Agents Node.js default, cascaded STT/LLM/TTS with vendor adapters and SIP; isolated long-running runtime. Benchmark speech-to-speech alternatives only after a measurable baseline.
selected_stack.payments: Gateway adapter; one sandbox-proven launch provider, Stripe or suitable regional gateway after eligibility verification; keep tenant customer payments separate from SaaS subscription billing.
selected_stack.storage: Private S3-compatible object storage with signed URLs, quarantine/scanning, lifecycle policies and encryption
selected_stack.communication: Transactional email adapter, actual inbound email connector, WhatsApp Business API and SMS adapters with consent controls
selected_stack.infrastructure: Docker images; Docker Compose for local development; managed container deployment as initial profile; Kubernetes manifests/Helm as enterprise profile when operationally justified. No mandatory Kubernetes cluster for local setup.
selected_stack.delivery: GitHub Actions, infrastructure as code, staging/production separation, immutable image versions
selected_stack.observability: OpenTelemetry + Grafana-compatible metrics/traces/logs, error tracking, structured redacted audit/operational logs
selected_stack.qa: Vitest or Jest chosen consistently, NestJS API integration tests, Playwright, pgTAP, accessibility checks, load tests and dependency/secret scans

architecture.style: API-first modular monolith with independently deployable background and voice workers; extract services only when measured scaling or isolation needs justify it.

apps.apps/marketing: Public website, product pages, pricing, CMS presentation and help center
apps.apps/workspace: Authenticated tenant workspace, onboarding and billing portal
apps.apps/api: NestJS modules, auth guards, domain services and REST API
apps.apps/worker: Outbox publishing, jobs, document ingestion, integrations and reports

shared_rules: Domain services own business decisions; controllers validate/map DTOs and invoke services.
REST /api/v1 and generated OpenAPI are mandatory. Add GraphQL only for a justified client requirement, with equivalent authorization, depth and query-cost controls.
Use explicit module interfaces/events; never let UI or another module write accounting tables directly.
Avoid distributed transactions by recording transaction+outbox atomically and reconciling external side effects.
Use separate control-plane and tenant authorization paths even when sharing a database.
architecture.processing_flow: UI/API client → verified identity → active tenant membership → entitlement/RBAC/ABAC → validated domain command → tenant-scoped transaction → audit and outbox → idempotent workers → provider reconciliation

features: Help center and searchable knowledge base
CMS draft, review, publish and revision history
SEO metadata, canonical URLs, sitemap, robots and applicable structured data
Accessible responsive English and Arabic pages
Real lead-form delivery with anti-abuse controls

Pricing uses the published plan catalogue
CTA carries selected plan into signup without trusting client prices
Draft CMS content is inaccessible publicly
Forms persist and route genuine enquiries

features: MFA and step-up for privileged actions
acceptance: Signup creates one organization and owner membership atomically
Repeated provisioning is idempotent
Users cannot select an unauthorized org via headers or URLs
Revoked membership loses access despite stale role claims
Owner transfer cannot leave an active organization ownerless

features: User and employee seat definitions with separate meters
Billing invoices, refunds and credit notes
acceptance: Client redirect cannot activate paid access
Verified provider state determines entitlements
Replayed/out-of-order events cannot duplicate charges or seats
Downgrade preserves business records and restricts future operations according to policy
Proration/renewal fixtures reconcile with provider sandbox
Platform billing is distinct from tenants invoicing their own customers

acceptance: Lead to accepted quote to project/invoice is functional
Stage moves persist and respect permissions
Quote changes create auditable revisions
Forecast values derive from actual scoped opportunities
Customer merge preserves source history and references

modules.name: HRMS and workforce
features: Leave policies, accrual ledger and balances
acceptance: Ordinary members cannot read salary or identity details
Employee sees only authorized own records
Payroll maker cannot approve own run
Effective-dated terms reproduce historical payroll
Leave approval adjusts balance exactly once
Training completion and certification evidence persist
Hiring recommendations require human decisions

modules.name: Accounting and finance
features: Chart of accounts and fiscal periods
Trial balance, P&L, balance sheet and cash flow
acceptance: Every posted entry balances in functional currency per legal entity
Posted entries and issued legal snapshots are immutable
Closed periods reject posting
Duplicate source events create at most one posting per purpose
Concurrent allocations cannot exceed payment/document balances
Reports reconcile to the ledger
Corporate tax is not a fixed percentage of invoice revenue

modules.name: Projects and tasks
acceptance: Dependencies cannot form cycles
Concurrent task edits detect version conflict
Approved time flows to billable drafts once
Capacity calculations include assigned hours and time off
Client portal cannot access private project discussion

acceptance: Quarantined objects cannot be downloaded or processed as accepted documents
Approval binds record version and proposed action hash
Workflow retries do not repeat side effects
Scheduled reports recheck recipient access at execution time
Search and exports preserve resource ACL

acceptance: Portal identity receives only explicit resource grants
SLA clock respects configured working calendar
AI handoff includes authorized context without leaking internal notes

Inbound duplicate events create one activity
Suppressed recipient is excluded even after a queued campaign retry
Provider failure is visible and recoverable

acceptance: Every tool enforces actual caller/tenant permissions server-side
Retrieval excludes unauthorized material before ranking/context construction
Financial/payroll/external-send actions require configured approval
Approval invalidates if recipient, amount or record version changes
Injection in source documents cannot expand tool permissions
Fallback model must satisfy data policy
Agent reports tool failure honestly

features: STT to LLM to TTS pipeline
Post-call summaries, disposition, CRM activities and proposed follow-up
acceptance: Actual sandbox call completes with interruption and handoff
No secrets or sensitive customer data disclosed before verification
Suppression is checked before every outbound attempt
Transcript/recording ACL differs from basic call metadata
Post-call workflow is idempotent
Provider outage gives a clear fallback

modules.name: Super Admin and platform control center
acceptance: Platform operator does not automatically read tenant business content
Support access requires reason, scope, expiry and audit
Price edits preserve existing contracted subscription terms
Suspending a tenant does not destroy legal records
Dangerous global configuration requires step-up and review policy

modules.name: Reporting, search and business intelligence
acceptance: Metrics use documented definitions and scoped source data
Stale search permissions cannot leak snippets/counts
Financial totals come from authoritative records rather than an AI estimate
Large exports are bounded async jobs with expiring signed access

all_interactive_screens: Accessible validated forms with server field errors
Search/filter/sort/pagination and saved views where useful
Real persisted data; fixture banners only in development/demo mode

ui_ux.direction: Premium warm glassmorphism with readable enterprise data surfaces. Preserve earlier video-2 sidebar styling when the supplied reference is available: translucent taupe/brown panel, thin light rim, white line icons, coral accent, pill highlight, collapse/expand, tooltips, project tree and avatar footer.
ui_ux.reference_truth: The earlier short reference shows a sidebar, not a whole dashboard. Do not claim exact unseen screens or known source font/shader values. If videos are unavailable, label reconstruction unverified and use documented design tokens.
requirements: Shared design tokens, spacing, typography, colors, radii and motion
Separate public marketing, tenant workspace and control-center navigation
High-opacity finance tables and forms for contrast
English/Arabic localization with full RTL/LTR
Logical CSS properties; isolated LTR identifiers, emails and phone numbers
Dark/light options, reduced-motion and opaque fallback
Accessible focus, labels, shortcuts, tooltips and keyboard drag alternatives
Mobile drawer, responsive forms and usable table overflow
Interactive prototype routes backed by fictional fixtures before production wiring
Versioned Playwright visual baselines for 1440, 1024, 768 and 390 CSS-pixel widths

authorization.policy: Deny by default. Require active identity and membership, appropriate tenant/entity scope, plan entitlement, RBAC grant and applicable ABAC conditions. Role names do not confer blanket access.
special_controls: No implicit tenant content access for platform operators
Time-bound reasoned support grants with scope, expiry and immutable audit
Maker/checker separation for payroll, payment, financial approval and sensitive global settings
Recheck permissions and source record versions when executing deferred jobs/AI tools
Server DTOs and separate sensitive-record access for salary, banking and identity fields

deliverables: Ordered reviewed SQL migrations and SQL RLS policies
Seed data for at least two tenants and multiple roles
conventions: UUID identifiers; org_id on tenant-owned records; created_at, updated_at and optimistic row_version where applicable.
Tenant-scoped unique constraints and composite (org_id,parent_id) foreign keys; also enforce same-entity accounts, fiscal periods and source documents.
Global plans/currencies/countries and identity/control-plane records use explicit separate access policies. Do not invent org_id semantics for global catalogs.
Use numeric/decimal money and serialize decimals as strings. Store currency, functional amount, historical FX rate/source/date, and tax snapshots. No binary floating-point money arithmetic.
Keep core domain fields normalized; JSON only for bounded validated settings, workflow definitions and immutable snapshots.
Foreign keys and ON DELETE RESTRICT for financial/legal history. Retention/legal holds govern eventual purge.
Polymorphic resource IDs require allowlisted typed link tables or checked target/tenant integrity, not an unverified UUID.
Indexes follow tenant/status/owner/date predicates and measured plans; keyset pagination for large tables.
Status changes use constrained state machines. Direct client updates to posted/approved/paid states are forbidden.
prisma_rls_boundary: Prisma does not automatically inherit authentication or tenant policy context. Use a server-only trusted identity transaction wrapper.
Verify issuer/audience/signature/session, resolve membership, then set transaction-local context with parameterized SQL on the SAME Prisma transaction connection as every scoped query.

Use non-owner NOBYPASSRLS runtime roles. Migration credentials never serve application requests. Enable/FORCE RLS on application-owned tables with explicit policies for global catalogs and identities.
Never use session-scoped settings on a shared pool, or a global Prisma client inside an active tenant transaction. Test rollback, error and concurrent pool reuse.
Use both USING and WITH CHECK for relevant operations. Deny missing context. Protect helpers from recursive policy errors and security-definer escalation.
Raw SQL must be parameterized and pass through the same boundary; no unsafe raw execution from user/model input.
These policies protect against request-level tenant mistakes; backend database credentials remain trusted and must be tightly restricted.
accounting_invariants: Journal debit equals credit per functional currency and legal entity at posting.
Posting is an atomic DB-controlled operation with open-period validation, source uniqueness, approval and locks. Deny direct edits/deletes to posted header/lines.
Corrections use reversal/credit documents, not mutation of history.
Issue numbers are unique and allocated safely; preserve void/gap explanation rather than pretending failed external requests never allocate numbers.
Separate invoice lifecycle, e-invoice transmission and payment settlement states.
Payment allocations, stock reservations if added, and credit allocations enforce aggregate limits under concurrent locking.
Payroll run totals reconcile to payslips, bank/WPS acknowledgements and journal entries.

requirements: OpenAPI generated/validated against DTOs
Cursor pagination with bounded limits
Allowlisted filters/sorts
ISO timestamps, explicit timezone and decimal strings
Stable {code,message,details,requestId} error shape
Optimistic version/ETag preconditions on edits
Idempotency key scoped to org, actor and operation with request hash; same key/different body returns conflict
202 plus job-status resource for long operations
Rate limits by endpoint, principal and tenant
Service and user credentials have distinct scoped permissions
api_contract.webhooks: Verify provider signature on raw body, replay window and event uniqueness. Resolve tenant from verified provider-account mapping; durably persist/enqueue before acknowledgement. Reconcile out-of-order/missed events against provider state.

rules: User can resume from durable state.
Creation and membership are transactional/idempotent.
Provider webhook arriving before browser return is supported.
Failed payment does not erase profile/progress or grant paid modules.
Provisioning failures have retry and operator visibility.
Trials require explicit effective dates, limits and conversion policy.
After readiness guide through entity settings, team invites, permissions, imports and first business task.

risk_tiers.external_action: Messages, calls, scheduling and workflow changes require configured preview/approval
risk_tiers.high_impact: Financial posting, money movement, payroll changes, deletion and access changes require explicit authorized human review; no autonomous model approval

ai_contract.rag_pipeline: Approved document → scan → extract → reviewed source/version → ACL-preserving chunks → embeddings → tenant/resource-filtered hybrid retrieval → cited answer. Revocation/deletion invalidates search and cached retrieval.
agent_rules: No arbitrary SQL, unrestricted URL fetch or unapproved tool/MCP installation.
Treat retrieved documents/emails/web pages as untrusted data, never permission to change rules.
Use egress allowlists and SSRF protection.
Tool execution uses real server permissions, not model assertions.
Approval binds action hash, recipient, amount, record version and expiry.
Model fallback must preserve tenant policy, region and data-processing requirements.
Redact secrets and minimize personal data in prompts/traces.
Enforce per-tenant/principal model, token, tool-step, time and spend limits.
Evaluate grounding, citation accuracy, task success, isolation, injection resistance and authorized tool correctness.
Hiring/performance assistance is advisory; no autonomous employment decisions.
voice_rules: Long-running separate service; never sustained calls inside a web request.
Vendor bake-off on consented Gulf Arabic, MSA, English and code-switching samples.
Measure entity recognition, completion, interruptions, p50/p95 response start and cost/minute.
Authorize outbound campaigns and recheck suppression on every attempt.
Record applicable consent/notice and recording policy version.
Verify caller before sensitive account disclosure; human transfer/failure fallback.
Store recordings/transcripts with restricted ACL and retention, not public URLs.
Post-call pipeline idempotently creates activity and draft follow-up.

requirements: Bilingual legal entity names/addresses, TRN and trade-licence metadata
Configurable fiscal years, branches, tax registrations and effective dates
Versioned VAT treatments, recoverability, rounding and AED tax conversion
UAE e-invoicing structured payload/ASP adapter with rejection, retry and legal archive
Country-specific tax, e-invoicing, employment and privacy adapters; UAE support is not universal GCC compliance
Regime-aware payroll, WPS provider validation, benefits, leave and settlement rules
Tenant retention/legal-hold policy and personal-data request workflows
Appropriate voice/marketing consent, suppression and provider approvals
Multi-currency precision including currencies with different minor units
uae_gcc_localization.verification_rule: Before coding and again before release, verify current official FTA, MoF, CBUAE, MoHRE, TDRA and relevant national sources; record URLs, effective dates and applicability. Do not hardcode regulatory deadlines or claim legal certification based on this prompt.
uae_gcc_localization.residency_rule: Map database/Auth/storage/backups/cache/search/jobs/AI/voice/telemetry/CDN/support access. In-region compute alone does not establish end-to-end residency. Fail closed for disallowed model/provider destinations.

rules: Business mutation, audit and outbox are one transaction.
Consumers assume at-least-once delivery, deduplicate and use provider idempotency keys.
Bounded retry/backoff/jitter, permanent error classification, dead-letter review and replay tooling.
Never trust an unauthenticated org_id in a webhook/job payload.
Check permissions/policy again before delayed sensitive actions.
Do not put full salaries, secrets or document content in event/queue payloads when references suffice.

security_requirements: Strict server authorization and query scoping for every entry point
MFA/step-up for privileged actions; secure cookie/session/CSRF and CORS policies
CSP and XSS-safe rich text rendering; validated uploads
TLS, at-rest encryption and field-level protection for high-sensitivity values
Secrets manager, least-privilege IAM and key rotation
Private buckets, quarantine, MIME/magic/size checks and short-lived signed access
Tenant-scoped cache keys and permission-version invalidation
Private authenticated realtime channels with reauthorization
Search indexing/retrieval guards including snippets, counts and aggregations; authoritative recheck before returning records
Audit append-only access plus retention/tamper-evident archive
Dependency, container and secret scanning; threat-model review and penetration test plan
No production customer data in development fixtures or CI previews

quality_targets.status: Proposed measurable budgets, not current results
quality_targets.initial_load_profile: 100 organizations, 50 simultaneous active users in a large tenant, one million representative CRM records; include noisy-neighbor tests and revise capacity from measurements
quality_targets.recovery: Proposed database RPO ≤15 minutes and RTO ≤4 hours only with adequate backup capabilities and successful restore drills; define storage/search/jobs separately
quality_targets.measurement: Record environment, dataset, concurrency, cache state and exclusions; separate AI/provider latency from core API targets.

acceptance_scenarios: Public visitor selects annual plan → registers/verifies → pays in sandbox → webhook activates correct entitlements → workspace provisioning succeeds → owner invites users.
Tenant A and B users cannot access each other via UUID guesses, joins, APIs, files, search snippets/counts, realtime, cache, reports, exports or RAG.
An employee is removed/SCIM-deprovisioned; subsequent requests and delayed sensitive actions fail despite earlier tokens.
Lead → opportunity → approved quote → project → approved time → invoice → partial receipt → final settlement → reconciled financial reports.
Concurrent invoice issue and duplicate payment webhook do not duplicate numbers, ledger postings or allocations.
Payroll prepared from effective terms/approved attendance is approved by a different person; payslips, provider batch and accounting reconcile.
AI answers from permitted sources with citations; malicious retrieved text cannot authorize an external action; changed payload invalidates approval.
Voice call handles interruption, failed provider and human handoff; post-call job creates one CRM activity and respects opt-out.
Plan downgrade/cancel/failure follows grace and retention policy without deleting tenant legal records.
Platform support session expires and loses tenant access; all access and changes retain audit evidence.
English and Arabic flows function across mobile/desktop, keyboard and reduced-motion settings.
Restore a backup into an isolated environment, reconstruct search indexes/jobs, and prove target recovery without altering production.

implementation_phases.name: Discovery and contracts
implementation_phases.work: Inspect repo, create PRD, glossary, requirement IDs, scope matrix, threat model, ADRs and entity diagrams. Resolve supported dependencies. Design API/resource ownership and deployment profiles.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: All modules/features mapped to requirements, entities, routes and intended tests.

implementation_phases.name: Workspace and engineering baseline
implementation_phases.work: Create pnpm/Turborepo workspace, apps, typed env validation, lint/typecheck/build/test scripts, local Docker services and CI skeleton.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Clean checkout starts locally; dependencies pinned; no secrets committed.

implementation_phases.name: Identity and tenant isolation
implementation_phases.work: Implement login/MFA, organizations/memberships, role/attribute policies, Prisma transaction context and SQL RLS.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Real PostgreSQL negative tests prove isolation, revocation and connection-pool context reset.

implementation_phases.name: Design system and application shells
implementation_phases.work: Implement premium glass sidebar, public website shell, workspace shell, control-center shell and Arabic/English navigation.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Keyboard/contrast/reduced-motion/RTL and responsive snapshots pass; observed vs proposed design recorded.

implementation_phases.name: Public website and catalogue
implementation_phases.work: Implement public routes, CMS lifecycle, help center, contact capture, published plan catalogue and SEO.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: All routes functional; draft content private; plan selection carries securely into registration.

implementation_phases.name: Subscription onboarding
implementation_phases.work: Implement trial, checkout, billing provider adapter, durable webhook ingest, provisioning, seats and entitlements.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Sandbox lifecycle/retry/out-of-order tests pass; success redirect alone grants nothing.

implementation_phases.name: CRM and commercial documents
implementation_phases.work: Implement lead/contact/account/pipeline/opportunity/product/quote/order flows and private document pipeline.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Lead to accepted quote works across roles; ACL, versioning and approvals verified.

implementation_phases.name: Accounting and UAE rule interfaces
implementation_phases.work: Implement GL, AR/AP, tax config, invoices, payments, allocations, reporting and bank reconciliation; add country/ASP adapter boundaries.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Ledger balancing, immutable posting, period locks, FX/rounding and concurrent allocation tests pass.

implementation_phases.name: Projects and collaboration
implementation_phases.work: Implement tasks, Gantt/dependencies, capacity, time, budgets, comments, internal messaging and notifications.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Quote to project to approved time to invoice draft verified; no cycles or duplicate billing.

implementation_phases.name: HR and payroll
implementation_phases.work: Implement workforce lifecycle, recruitment, leave/attendance, training, reviews, payroll, payslips and reviewed WPS/benefit adapters.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Protected-field access and maker/checker tests pass; jurisdiction/provider fixtures reviewed.

implementation_phases.name: Operations and customer service
implementation_phases.work: Implement approvals/workflows, service tickets, SLA, external portals, reports, search and import/export.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Workflow retry, search ACL, portal isolation and timed SLA scenarios verified.

implementation_phases.name: AI tools and governance
implementation_phases.work: Implement authorized RAG, assistants, tool registry, approvals, budgets, tracing and evaluation harness.

implementation_phases.name: Voice and communication adapters
implementation_phases.work: Implement actual sandbox email/WhatsApp/voice workflows, consent gates, suppression, handoff and post-call processing.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Provider-backed sandbox evidence and measured voice quality/latency; unavailable credentials clearly blocked.

implementation_phases.name: Platform operations and advanced administration
implementation_phases.work: Complete super admin, operator roles, tenant lifecycle, support grants, usage dashboards, connector health and enterprise SSO/SCIM.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: No default cross-tenant content access; support grant expiry and deprovisioning verified.

implementation_phases.name: Hardening and staging
implementation_phases.work: Run complete acceptance matrix, security/accessibility/load tests, migration rehearsal, backup restoration and staged deployment.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Critical paths pass with actual reports; blockers enumerated; no unexplained financial imbalance.

implementation_phases.name: Production release and maintenance handover
implementation_phases.work: Prepare production configs, reviewed rollout/rollback, canary checks, monitoring ownership, runbooks and maintenance schedule. Deploy only within explicit authorization.
implementation_phases.exit_gate: Release checklist and provider verification complete; clean repository and accurate readiness report delivered.

Prisma schema plus reviewed SQL migrations/RLS/functions
UI design tokens and interactive prototype states
ER diagrams, data dictionary, PRD and architecture ADRs
Actual test and visual comparison reports
Docker/Compose, deployment profile and optional Helm/Kubernetes/IaC
GitHub Actions with staged migration and release gates
Provider contract fixtures and real sandbox adapters
Runbooks for deployment, rollback, restore, incident and provider failure

rules: Do not pretend scripts exist or passed before running them.
Production migrations run once from a privileged controlled job; application containers use runtime credentials.
Expand/migrate/contract changes with rollback-compatible application versions; no production schema push or automatic destructive reset.
Staging uses independent services, secrets and sandbox providers.
Require all critical tests, migration review, restore drill, security triage and provider verification before release.
Configure health/readiness probes, graceful shutdown, resource limits, DB pool budgets, queue concurrency, autoscaling and alert ownership.
Document unresolved external dependencies as blockers and disable their production paths.

must_include: What works with links to implementation
Local versus sandbox versus production integration status
Database migration and data compatibility status
UI reference fidelity and proposed designs
Deploy/run commands and secret configuration locations
forbidden_claims: All modules complete when only placeholders exist
Exact visual replication of unavailable or unseen reference screens

first_action: Read this entire JSON, inspect the repository and its instructions, then create the requirement matrix and implementation status. Start P00 and P01, run the relevant checks, and continue through the defined dependencies. Implement files and working features; do not return only a plan.
